description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests designed to verify the behavior of Git commands, particularly related to tags, branches, and references, with various argument options and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting it to succeed, runs the command sequence, and checks output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, capturing error output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file or output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Tests if specific pattern exists within the output.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a given message in the test repository.
